description: Set up Vite project scaffold with all dependencies, base HTML structure, CSS design system, and GitHub Pages deployment configuration. This establishes the complete project foundation including the visual design language (liquid glass, pastel ecological palette, generous whitespace).
steps: Initialize package.json with npm init, set name to 'eco-cinema-observatory', type to 'module'
Install dependencies: three (for 3D globe), gsap (for scroll animations including ScrollTrigger), vite (dev dependency for build tooling)
Create vite.config.js with base path set to '/species-on-screen/' for GitHub Pages deployment

Create index.html at project root as Vite entry point. Structure it as a single-page scrollytelling experience with these semantic sections: (1) #hero - immersive landing with observatory title and ambient background, (2) #globe-section - the living world interactive globe, (3) #concept-section - what the observatory does, (4) #species-section - tiger prototype species profile, (5) #vision-section - where this is going. Each section should be full-viewport height minimum. Include a subtle fixed navigation indicator (dots or minimal progress bar) on the side.

Create src/style.css with the complete design system: CSS custom properties for the ecological pastel palette (--color-forest: soft sage green, --color-water: pale turquoise/cyan, --color-savanna: warm ochre/amber, --color-mist: translucent white, --color-ice: cool lavender-white), liquid glass surface styles (backdrop-filter blur, subtle borders, translucent backgrounds), typography (clean sans-serif, generous line-height, contemplative spacing), scroll-snap behavior, section transitions, responsive breakpoints. The overall feel must be: light backgrounds, dreamy, morning-light-through-forest-canopy, NOT dark mode, NOT generic glassmorphism.
Create src/main.js as the application entry point that imports style.css, initializes GSAP ScrollTrigger, and orchestrates section loading

Create .github/workflows/deploy.yml - GitHub Actions workflow that builds with Vite and deploys to GitHub Pages on push to main branch. Use actions/configure-pages, actions/upload-pages-artifact pointing to dist/, and actions/deploy-pages.
Verify the project builds successfully with npm run build and produces a dist/ directory with the bundled output
acceptance_criteria: npm run build produces a dist/ directory containing index.html and bundled JS/CSS assets
index.html contains all 5 scrollytelling sections with proper semantic structure
CSS design system implements the ecological pastel palette with liquid glass surfaces on a light background
.github/workflows/deploy.yml exists and is valid YAML for GitHub Pages deployment
vite.config.js sets base to '/species-on-screen/' for correct asset paths on GitHub Pages
verification: Run 'npm install' in /projects/sandbox/species-on-screen and confirm exit code 0
Run 'npm run build' in /projects/sandbox/species-on-screen and confirm exit code 0 and dist/ directory exists
Confirm dist/index.html exists and contains section IDs: hero, globe-section, concept-section, species-section, vision-section
findings: Build completes in ~87ms. Vite v8.0.14 used. Three.js and GSAP bundled together produce ~114KB JS gzipped to ~45KB. All 5 section IDs present in dist/index.html. No test framework needed - validation is build success.
